title: Syrian Massaman Lamb Wrap
description: A fusion of Syrian and Southeast Asian flavors, this adventurous wrap features tender lamb, crispy vegetables, and a hint of warm spices. Serve with a side of tangy tahini sauce for dipping.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the Massaman curry paste, olive oil, onion, garlic, cucumber, tomato, and red pepper. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the lamb shoulder, curry paste mixture, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix well to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the lamb from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Grill the lamb for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Transfer the lamb to a cutting board and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing it thinly.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the wraps by placing a few slices of the lamb on each pita bread, followed by a spoonful of the tahini sauce, some parsley, and a sprinkle of sumac.
